subject.title: Control UI: Memory panel for MEMORY.md and USER.md

question: Should OpenClaw add a dedicated core Control UI Memory editor now, or wait for broader workspace-file/plugin Control UI contribution decisions to settle first?
rationale: The requested UX is useful but crosses browser authorization, prompt-context mutation, memory ownership, and overlapping plugin/workspace UI surfaces, so automation should not choose the product boundary alone.

options.title: Design scoped Memory editor
options.body: Approve a narrow core memory-files API and Control UI panel with date validation, admin-scoped writes, audit/diff feedback, and tests before implementation.

options.title: Fold into workspace file manager
options.body: Treat the broad workspace-file manager as the owning surface and close or narrow this issue after that path lands with memory-specific affordances.

options.title: Defer to plugin contribution slots
options.body: Wait for the Control UI plugin-slot RFC to define safe host-rendered panels, then build the memory panel as a memory plugin contribution.

recommendation.title: Design scoped Memory editor
recommendation.body: Approve a narrow core memory-files API and Control UI panel with date validation, admin-scoped writes, audit/diff feedback, and tests before implementation.

likelyOwner.reason: They are the best available routing candidate for the product/security boundary because this touches core agent context, Gateway methods, and Control UI direction.
